description:
Decide and document the production storage path for images generated by swarm-manager image CLI helper. Research conclusion proposes archive/generated/ as PNGs + index.json — pin the production path before any execute work depends on it.

Must resolve: (1) local filesystem path (likely ~/.vrooli/swarm-manager/generated-images/) vs MinIO vs embedded data URIs; (2) cleanup/retention policy; (3) backward-compat for items already referencing image_url.

Downstream items blocked on this contract: swarm-manager-image-cli-helper (writes to it), workshop-option-image-rendering (reads from it), decision-image-handoff-propagation (copies from it).

Output: design doc / ADR-style decision under scenarios/swarm-manager/initiatives/ai-image-generation-foundation/, plus update orchestration-summary.md to remove the unresolved-questions entry for storage location.

Why now: Surfaced during 2026-04-25 vision-walk audit — execution gap identified by operator. Pattern caught: brand-manager rollout failed because handoff context didn't reach the scenario; same risk here without contract lock-in.
name: image-storage-location-decision
title: Lock image storage location for swarm-manager generated mockups
